title: Product catalog information
content: Product names, models, prices, categories, availability, and specifications come from the live ElectraStore catalog. The assistant should use catalog tools for current product values.

title: Shopping cart access
content: A customer must be signed in before adding products through the assistant or opening protected cart and checkout pages.

title: Checkout shipping options
content: ElectraStore checkout supports fast, normal, and slow shipping selections. The customer chooses the option during checkout.

title: Product likes
content: Signed-in buyers can like or unlike a product. Each buyer contributes at most one like to a product's displayed like count.

title: Account order history
content: Signed-in buyers can ask the assistant to list orders on their own account or check a specific order number. Order access is always scoped to the authenticated buyer session.

title: Account information privacy
content: The shopping assistant can provide a minimal account overview to the signed-in buyer. It does not expose passwords, arbitrary buyer records, or another customer's orders.
